sources.title: MiniMax Music 3: The Open-Weight AI Music Model, Explained
sources.snippet: MiniMax Music 3 is an open-weight text-to-music model released by MiniMax, the same company behind the open-weight video generator Hailuo (also referred to as H3 in some coverage) and the Seance 2.5 model. Music 3 takes a text prompt, and in some workflows a style or lyric reference, and generates a full song with vocals and instrumentation.
